# kion_automation_policy (Resource)

Manages a Kion Automation Policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_automation_policy" "example" {
  # Required
  cloud_provider_policies = [{
    # apply_to_all_regions = false
    # cloud_provider_id    = 1
    # policy               = "example"
    # regions              = []
    # resources            = []
  }]
  name                    = "example"

  # Optional
  # cloud_rule_ids       = []
  # description          = "example"
  # enabled              = false
  # engine               = 1
  # owner_user_group_ids = []
  # owner_user_ids       = []
  # scheduled_frequency = {
  #   days_of_month        = []
  #   days_of_week         = []
  #   end_date             = "example"
  #   hour                 = 1
  #   interval_hours       = 1
  #   minute               = 1
  #   quarterly_recurrence = 1
  #   start_date           = "example"
  #   time_zone_identifier = "example"
  #   type                 = 1
  #   weekly_recurrence    = 1
  # }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cloud_provider_policies` (Attributes List) The provider-specific policies this automation policy runs. At least one is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_provider_policies))
- `name` (String) Name of the automation policy. Must be unique.

### Optional

- `cloud_rule_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the cloud rules the policy is attached to.
- `description` (String) Description of the automation policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is enabled.
- `engine` (Number) Engine that runs the policy: 0 (Kion) or 1 (Cloud Custodian). Kion rejects creating a policy with 1, but existing ones can be imported.
- `owner_user_group_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the user groups that own the policy.
- `owner_user_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the users who own the policy.
- `scheduled_frequency` (Attributes) When the policy runs. Omit for a policy that only runs on demand. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--scheduled_frequency))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--cloud_provider_policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_provider_policies`

Optional:

- `apply_to_all_regions` (Boolean) Whether the policy applies to every region rather than the listed ones.
- `cloud_provider_id` (Number) ID of the cloud provider this policy targets.
- `policy` (String) The policy body.
- `regions` (List of String) Regions the policy runs in when apply_to_all_regions is false.
- `resources` (List of String) Resource types the policy acts on, for example ec2.


<a id="nestedatt--scheduled_frequency"></a>
### Nested Schema for `scheduled_frequency`

Optional:

- `days_of_month` (List of Number) Days of the month to run on. Monthly only.
- `days_of_week` (List of Number) Days of the week to run on, 0 = Sunday. Weekly only.
- `end_date` (String) Date the schedule stops.
- `hour` (Number) Hour of the day to run at
- `interval_hours` (Number) Run every N hours. Interval only.
- `minute` (Number) Minute of the hour to run at
- `quarterly_recurrence` (Number) Which month of the quarter to run in. Quarterly only.
- `start_date` (String) Date the schedule starts.
- `time_zone_identifier` (String) IANA time zone the hour and minute are interpreted in, for example America/New_York.
- `type` (Number) Frequency type. 0 = daily, 1 = weekly, 2 = monthly, 3 = quarterly, 4 = interval.
- `weekly_recurrence` (Number) Run every N weeks. Weekly only.
